listings.release_notes:
Sonos 27.1.1
————————
• Improved searching with autocomplete suggestions
• Queued content now persists during radio or TV playback
• Improved system update visibility in settings

listings.name: Sonos S1 Controller
listings.release_notes: Renamed the Sonos S1 Controller, this app supports systems that include the oldest Sonos products. Systems supported by this app will continue to receive bug fixes and security patches but will not receive new software features found in the new Sonos S2 app and will not be compatible with Sonos products released after May 2020. For more information, please visit https://support.sonos.com/topic/sonos-apps
